_note: SAMPLE DATA for demo only. ABC Technologies is a fictional company.

company.name: ABC Technologies
company.description: A reporting and workflow app that helps teams create reports faster.

style_rules: Use 'you' and 'we' to speak directly to the reader.
Use at most one exclamation mark per post.
Keep sentences under 25 words where possible.

preferred.meaning: Use instead of 'users' when talking about companies.

rules.title: Pricing language
rules.text: Do not describe the product as 'cheap' or 'cheapest'. Use 'affordable'.

rules.title: Superlatives need evidence
rules.text: Claims such as 'fastest', 'best', 'number one' or 'most popular' are allowed only with approved evidence in the Fact Vault.

rules.title: No guarantees
rules.text: Do not guarantee outcomes or use absolute promises such as '100% success' or 'double your sales'.

rules.title: No exaggeration
rules.text: Avoid exaggerated words such as 'revolutionary' or 'game-changing'. Describe a specific benefit instead.

rules.title: Protect customer data
rules.text: Never include customer names, phone numbers or emails in public content.

rules.title: Regulated claims go to a human
rules.text: Any health, financial or legal claim must be reviewed by an authorised reviewer.

rules.title: Exclamation marks
rules.text: Use at most one exclamation mark per post.

approved_facts.claim: ABC App helps teams generate reports.
ABC App is used by more than 500 teams.
ABC App plans start at Rs 549 per month.
ABC App reduced report preparation time by 30% in an internal benchmark of 40 teams.
